hooks.name: Block Destructive DB Commands
hooks.description: Prevents execution of destructive database commands like db:wipe, migrate:fresh, migrate:reset, DROP DATABASE. Forces safe alternatives (drop specific table, create fix migration).

action.prompt: STOP. Check if this command contains any of these destructive patterns: db:wipe, migrate:fresh, migrate:reset, DROP DATABASE, truncate. If it does, you are FORBIDDEN from running it. Instead suggest a safe alternative like dropping only the specific problematic table or creating a new fix migration. NEVER destroy all data to fix a single table issue.
